purpose: Concrete acceptance artifact for the live_runner_auditor_accepted OPEN gate. The status gate requires accepted==true AND a live_runner_entrypoint that exists on disk and compiles (py_compile for .py, bash -n for .sh) AND live_runner_route == ledger.locked.route. Flipping accepted alone, or accepting a runner whose route differs from the locked route, is insufficient and still fails the gate.
acceptance_discipline: live_runner_route is a self-declared string the gate compares to locked.route; it does not prove the entrypoint actually drives that route. Before setting accepted=true, the Auditor MUST verify the cited entrypoint really executes the declared route (e.g. ROS2 driver action, not a TP/bridge call).
revoked_reason: Accepted false pending Auditor review of the Step5b velocity-admittance runner. The prior repeated-short-FJT final contact route is retained only as pre-velocity evidence; final contact acceptance must verify forward_velocity_admittance plus the constrained Stage22 preposition implementation.
artifact_schema: summary.json plus step5b_velocity_admittance_trace.csv; summary records authorization, dry_run, execute_live_contact, contact_control_strategy, velocity_command_topic, velocity_command_sent, controller_switch, failure_stage, trace_path, trace_rows, diagnostic_summary, and kunwei_monitor
